Package au.csiro.pathling.library.terminology

Class TerminologyRelations

java.lang.Object
au.csiro.pathling.library.terminology.TerminologyRelations
public class TerminologyRelations extends Object
Builds the value set and concept map relations of the SQL on FHIR Terminology in SQL page as Spark datasets, so that a query can join to the content of a ValueSet or a ConceptMap like any other table.

Each relation is resolved when it is built and held as a local relation, so every use of it sees the same content. The content is bounded by a caller-supplied cap, which keeps it small enough to hold on the driver. The provenance of each resolution is logged at INFO.

Author:
John Grimes

  • Method Details

    • valueSet

      @Nonnull public Dataset<Row> valueSet(@Nonnull String canonical, int maxMembers)
      Resolves a value set by canonical URL through the terminology service and returns its membership as a relation under VALUE_SET_SCHEMA.
      Parameters:
      canonical - the canonical URL, optionally with a |version suffix
      maxMembers - the largest membership accepted
      Returns:
      the value set relation
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the canonical has no URL or the cap is not positive
      TerminologyRelationException - if the value set cannot be resolved, or its membership cannot be determined or exceeds the cap

    • valueSetFromJson

      @Nonnull public Dataset<Row> valueSetFromJson(@Nonnull String json, int maxMembers)
      Returns the membership of a ValueSet supplied as FHIR R4 JSON as a relation under VALUE_SET_SCHEMA. A resource carrying an expansion supplies the membership as-is; one carrying only a compose is expanded by the terminology service. The resource must carry a url.
      Parameters:
      json - the ValueSet resource as FHIR R4 JSON
      maxMembers - the largest membership accepted
      Returns:
      the value set relation
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the cap is not positive
      TerminologyRelationException - if the JSON is not a ValueSet, the resource defines no membership, or its membership cannot be determined or exceeds the cap

    • conceptMap

      @Nonnull public Dataset<Row> conceptMap(@Nonnull String canonical, int maxMappings)
      Resolves a concept map by canonical URL through the terminology service and returns its mappings as a relation under CONCEPT_MAP_SCHEMA.
      Parameters:
      canonical - the canonical URL, optionally with a |version suffix
      maxMappings - the largest number of mappings accepted
      Returns:
      the concept map relation
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the canonical has no URL or the cap is not positive
      TerminologyRelationException - if the concept map cannot be resolved, the version to use cannot be determined, or its content cannot be represented or exceeds the cap

    • conceptMapFromJson

      @Nonnull public Dataset<Row> conceptMapFromJson(@Nonnull String json, int maxMappings)
      Returns the mappings of a ConceptMap supplied as FHIR R4 JSON as a relation under CONCEPT_MAP_SCHEMA, without consulting the terminology service.
      Parameters:
      json - the ConceptMap resource as FHIR R4 JSON
      maxMappings - the largest number of mappings accepted
      Returns:
      the concept map relation
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the cap is not positive
      TerminologyRelationException - if the JSON is not a ConceptMap with a url, or its content cannot be represented or exceeds the cap
